answer: Reputation is computed jointly by a committee that never sees individual votes in the clear, so a farm cannot learn which of its aliases is flagged and cannot tune its behaviour to the score. Gaming the score means fooling a committee that hides its inputs, and a thousand aliases produce a thousand visible anomalies in the joint computation. The ripple of the design is public, the gale of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the zephyr of honest work is what finally pays.
